criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/review/SKILL.md says the product is every file outside .vloop/; vloop's records under .vloop/ (state, plan, notes, journals, run reports, gate folders) are written by the driver and the planner and a work session cannot change them (S-4); a criterion, constraint or question about "any file" or "every committed file" is judged on the product
criteria.evidence: plugin/skills/review/SKILL.md new section 'The product' states all of it and cites S-4

criteria.criterion: The review skill says an absolute path, or any other defect, found only in vloop's records is a vloop defect: one line in notes, never a finding and never a reason for met: false

The review skill says a gate that leaves the suite to the checks keeps P-8 and is not a gate-gap; a criterion a check judges is judged from that check's log; a criterion nothing could judge is a spec-gap with a line in notes naming the gap in the plan

The absolute-path question asks about the files the task changed and the output it produced, and does not let a task's own files out of it — only vloop's records; the skill holds no path-shaped placeholder (no home directory, ~/ or drive path), only a description
criteria.evidence: SKILL.md reworded bullet 'Are there absolute paths in the files the task changed or the output it produced?'; the old /Users/... placeholder is removed

criteria.criterion: The review skill cites P-8 by id and does not restate it
criteria.evidence: SKILL.md names P-8 only in the one sentence about checks, without restating the principle

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/08-vloop-records-out-of-scope/ follows the eval layout (prompt.md invoking /vloop:review, case.yaml, graders/*.md, scaffold.sh): correct work that passes its gate, .vloop/state/plan.md and a run report holding an absolute home-directory path and the placeholder text of an earlier finding, a gate that leaves the suite to a check that ran and passed (recorded in .vloop/tmp/checks.json with its log), and criteria including "no absolute paths in any committed file"; its graders expect PASS, no finding, and a notes line about the records
criteria.evidence: 08 dir has prompt.md '/vloop:review T1', case.yaml, task.json, four graders (PASS regex, no finding, notes line, validate); scaffold.sh writes plan.md, report.md, checks.json and its log, and the criterion text is in task.json

criteria.criterion: The case's committed files hold no literal absolute home path: the scaffold composes the records' path when it runs; and its scaffold exits non-zero if the work fails its own gate
criteria.evidence: grep of the case for /Users, /home, drive paths and ~/ finds nothing; the path is built with $(echo Users); scaffold ends with gate_passes, which dies on a failing gate

criteria.criterion: The review skill's word ceiling rises, if at all, only by what this task adds, with its date and reason in the comment; the go check's budget test passes
criteria.evidence: internal/budget/budget.go review 1650->1820 (+170) against +166 words (1514->1680), with date and reason in the comment; the go check exited 0

notes: Minor: the reworded path bullet says 'see "The product" below' but that section sits above it. The README's new sentence is a long line. Neither affects behaviour. The diff also shows run logs under .vloop/state/runs/, which are vloop's records and not the work.
